instructions.question: `message` is a support ticket. Which queue should handle it, judged from the message alone?
notes: A message that mixes a bug with a billing complaint goes to the queue of the thing the sender asks to be done.

billing.what: Charges, invoices, refunds, subscription price or plan changes, payment failures
billing.not_for: questions about plan features before buying (sales) or a login problem (account_access)
examples: I was charged twice this month

technical.what: The product misbehaves: errors, crashes, wrong output, slowness, an integration or API not working
technical.not_for: cannot log in (account_access) or pricing questions (sales)
examples: dashboard has been loading for minutes

account_access.what: Cannot sign in, locked out, password or two-factor problems, changing the email on the account
account_access.not_for: billing questions or bugs after a successful login

sales.what: A prospective or current customer asking about plans, pricing tiers, quotes, trials, or whether the product can do something before buying
sales.not_for: an existing customer disputing a charge (billing)
examples: do you offer an enterprise plan
can I get a quote for 50 seats

other.what: None of the above: spam, feedback with no request, partnership or press enquiries, unrelated messages
other.not_for: anything with a concrete request the other queues cover
examples: would you like to sponsor our podcast

urgent.instructions: Does `message` say or clearly imply that the sender needs attention today: an ongoing outage or a whole team blocked, a same-day deadline, money leaving the account right now, locked out of a live system, or a security exposure or data leak?

criteria.true: an ongoing outage, a same-day deadline, money leaving now, locked out of something live, or a security exposure or data leak
criteria.false: a routine request, a question, feedback, a decision with a horizon of days, or a problem the sender is living with

contains_secret.instructions: Does `message` contain a credential or secret that should be redacted before the ticket is stored: a password, an API key or token, a full card number, or a one-time code?

criteria.true: an actual secret value appears in the text
criteria.false: secrets are mentioned but no value is present
